readings.title: The Wrath of YeHoVaH Against the Nations
readings.subtitle: The Heavens Rolled Like a Scroll
readings.text: [Isaiah 34:1] Come near, you nations, to hear. And listen, you people! Let the earth hear, and all that is in it, the world and all its offspring. [2] For the displeasure of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is against all the nations, and <dn>His</dn> wrath against all their divisions. <dn>He</dn> shall put <dn>את</dn> them under the ban, <dn>He</dn> shall give them over to the slaughter, [3] and their slain be thrown out, and their stench rise from their corpses. And mountains shall be melted with their blood. [4] And all <dn>את</dn> the host of the heavens shall rot away. And <dn>את</dn> the heavens shall be rolled up like a scroll, and all their host fade like a leaf fading on the vine, and like the fading one of a fig tree.

readings.title: The Sword of Vengeance on Edom
readings.subtitle: The Day of Recompense for Zion
readings.text: [Isaiah 34:5] <dq>“For <dn>My</dn> sword shall be drenched in the heavens. Look, it comes down on Eḏom, and on the people of <dn>My</dn> curse, for judgment.</dq> [6] <dq>“The sword of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shall be filled with blood, it shall be made overflowing with fatness, and with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams. For <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has a slaughtering in Botsrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Eḏom.</dq> [7] <dq>“And wild oxen shall come down with them, and young bulls with bulls. And their land shall be drenched with blood, and their dust made fat with fatness.”</dq> [8] For it is the day of the vengeance of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, the year of recompense for the cause of Tsiyon.

readings.title: The Perpetual Desolation of Edom
readings.subtitle: A Habitation for Wild Beasts
readings.text: [Isaiah 34:9] And its streams shall be turned into tar, and its dust into sulphur, and its land shall become burning tar, [10] that is not quenched night or day, its smoke going up forever. From generation to generation it lies waste, no one passes through it forever and ever, [11] so that the pelican and the porcupine possess it, also the owl and the raven dwell in it. And <dn>He</dn> shall stretch out over it <dn>את</dn> the line of formlessness and <dn>את</dn> stones of emptiness. [12] Its caves, with no one in them, is called a reign, but all its rulers have vanished. [13] And thorns shall come up in its palaces, nettles and brambles in its strongholds. And it shall be a home for jackals, a courtyard for ostriches. [14] And the wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the jackals, and the shaggy goat call to its companion. The night creature shall also settle there, and shall find for herself a place of rest. [15] The arrow snake shall nest there, and lay eggs and hatch, and gather them under her shadow. There too the vultures shall gather, each with its mate. [16] Search from the book of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and read: not one of these shall be missing, not one shall be without a mate, for <dn>He</dn> has commanded my mouth. And <dn>His</dn> Spirit shall gather them. [17] And <dn>He</dn> shall cast the lot for them, and <dn>His</dn> hand shall divide it among them with a measuring line – they possess it forever, from generation to generation they dwell in it.

readings.title: The Desert Shall Rejoice
readings.subtitle: The Excellency of Our Elohim Revealed
readings.text: [Isaiah 35:1] Let the wilderness and the dry place be glad for them, and let the desert rejoice, and blossom as the rose. [2] It blossoms much and rejoices, even with joy and singing. The esteem of Leḇanon shall be given to it, the excellence of Karmel and Sharon. They shall see <dn>את</dn> the esteem of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, the excellency of our <dn>Elohim</dn>. [3] Strengthen the weak hands, and make firm the weak knees. [4] Say to those with anxious heart, <dq>“Be strong, do not fear! See, your <dn>Elohim</dn> comes with vengeance, with the recompense of <dn>Elohim</dn>. <dn>He</dn> is coming to save you.”</dq>

readings.title: The Way of Set-apartness
readings.subtitle: The Ransomed of YeHoVaH Shall Return
readings.text: [Isaiah 35:5] Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf be opened. [6] Then the lame shall leap like a deer, and the tongue of the dumb sing, because waters shall burst forth in the wilderness, and streams in the desert. [7] And the parched ground shall become a pool, and the thirsty land springs of water – in the home for jackals, where each lay, grass with reeds and rushes. [8] And there shall be a highway, and a way, and it shall be called “The Way of Set-apartness.” The unclean does not pass over it, but it is for those who walk the way, and no fools wander on it. [9] No lion is there, nor any ravenous beast go up on it, it is not found there. But the redeemed shall walk there. [10] And the ransomed of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shall return and enter Tsiyon with singing, with everlasting joy on their heads. They shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.

readings.title: Judgment on Those Who Seize Land
readings.subtitle: A Time of Evil
readings.text: [Micah 2:1] Woe to those plotting wickedness, and working out evil upon their beds! In the light of the morning they practise it, because it is in the might of their hand. [2] And they coveted fields and seized them, also houses, and took them away. And they oppressed a man and his house, a man and his inheritance. [3] Therefore thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“See, against this clan <dn>I</dn> am planning evil, from which you do not remove <dn>את</dn> your necks, nor walk proudly, for this is a time of evil.</dq> [4] <dq>“In that day one shall lift up a proverb against you, and he shall lament with a bitter lamentation, and shall say, ‘We have been utterly ravaged! <dn>He</dn> changes the inheritance of <dn>my</dn> people. How <dn>He</dn> removes it from me! <dn>He</dn> apportions our fields to the backslider.’ ”</dq> [5] <dq>“Therefore you shall have no one in the assembly of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> to divide the land by lot.</dq>

readings.title: Rejection of True Prophets
readings.subtitle: The People Desire Preachers of Wine
readings.text: [Micah 2:6] <dq>“You do not preach, they preach. They do not preach to these, reproaches are not turned back.</dq> [7] <dq>“Are you called ‘House of Ya‛aqoḇ’? Has the Spirit of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> been limited? Are these <dn>His</dn> doings? Do not <dn>My</dn> words do good to the one walking uprightly?</dq> [8] <dq>“And lately <dn>My</dn> people have risen up as an enemy. You strip off <dn>את</dn> the robe with the garment from those who trust you, as they pass by – those returning from battle.</dq> [9] <dq>“You have driven the women of <dn>My</dn> people from their pleasant houses. You have taken away <dn>My</dn> splendour from their children forever.</dq> [10] <dq>“Arise and go, for this is not your rest, because uncleanness destroys, and the destruction is grievous.</dq> [11] <dq>“If a man walking after wind and falsehood has lied: ‘<dn>I</dn> preach to you of wine and of strong drink,’ he shall be the ‘preacher’ of this people!</dq>

readings.title: The Remnant of Israel Gathered
readings.subtitle: The Breach-Maker Goes Before Them
readings.text: [Micah 2:12] <dq>“<dn>I</dn> shall certainly gather <dn>את</dn> all of you, O Ya‛aqoḇ, <dn>I</dn> shall bring together <dn>את</dn> the remnant of Yisra’ěl, put them together like sheep of the fold, like a flock in the midst of their pasture, they being noisy because of men.</dq> [13] <dq>“The breach-maker shall go up before them. They shall break out, and pass through the gate, and go out by it, and their sovereign pass before them, with <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> at their head!”</dq>

readings.title: Rulers Who Devour the People
readings.subtitle: Hating Good and Loving Evil
readings.text: [Micah 3:1] Then <dn>I</dn> said, “Hear now, O heads of Ya‛aqoḇ, and you rulers of the house of Yisra’ěl: Should you not know <dn>את</dn> right-ruling, [2] you who are hating good and loving evil, tearing away the skin from <dn>My</dn> people, and the flesh from their bones, [3] and who have eaten <dn>את</dn> the flesh of <dn>My</dn> people, and stripped off <dn>את</dn> their skin, and have broken <dn>את</dn> their bones, and have cut it up as into a pot, like flesh in the cooking pot?” [4] Therefore, when they cry to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>He</dn> does not answer them, and hides <dn>His</dn> face from them at that time, as they have made their deeds evil.

readings.title: False Prophets Judged
readings.subtitle: Micah Filled with the Spirit of YeHoVaH
readings.text: [Micah 3:5] Thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> concerning the prophets who lead my people astray, who are biting with their teeth and have called out, “Peace!” They even set apart a battle against him who does not give for their mouths. [6] <dq>Therefore it shall be night to you without vision, and darkness to you without divination. The sun shall go down on the prophets, and the day shall be dark for them.</dq> [7] <dq>And the seers shall be ashamed, and the diviners embarrassed. And they shall all cover their lips, for there is no answer, O <dn>Elohim</dn>.</dq> [8] But truly <dn>I</dn> am filled with power, with the Spirit of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and with right-ruling and with might, to declare to Ya‛aqoḇ his transgression and to Yisra’ěl his sin.

readings.title: Zion's Destruction Foretold
readings.subtitle: Leaders Who Judge for a Bribe
readings.text: [Micah 3:9] Hear this, please, you heads of the house of Ya‛aqoḇ and you rulers of the house of Yisra’ěl, who despise right-ruling and distort all that is straight, [10] those building up Tsiyon with bloodshed and Yerushalayim with unrighteousness. [11] Her heads judge for a bribe, her priests teach for pay, and her prophets divine for a price. Yet they lean on <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and say, “Is not <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> in our midst? Evil does not come upon us.” [12] Therefore, because of you, Tsiyon is ploughed like a field, and Yerushalayim becomes heaps, and the mountain of the House like a wooded height.

readings.title: The Reign of Peace from Zion
readings.subtitle: Swords into Ploughshares
readings.text: [Micah 4:1] And in the latter days it shall be that the mountain of the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is established on the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills. And peoples shall flow to it. [2] And many nations shall come and say, “Come, and let us go up to the mountain of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, to the House of the <dn>Elohim</dn> of Ya‛aqoḇ, and let <dn>Him</dn> teach us <dn>His</dn> ways, and let us walk in <dn>His</dn> paths. For out of Tsiyon comes forth the Torah, and the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> from Yerushalayim.” [3] And <dn>He</dn> shall judge among many peoples, and reprove strong nations afar off. They shall beat their swords into plough shares, and their spears into pruning hooks – nation shall not lift up <dn>את</dn> sword against nation, neither teach battle any more. [4] But each one shall sit under his vine and under his fig tree, with no one to make them afraid, for the mouth of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts has spoken. [5] For all the peoples walk, each one in the name of his mighty one, but we walk in the Name of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> our <dn>Elohim</dn> forever and ever.

readings.title: The Gathering and Triumph of Zion
readings.subtitle: Delivered from Babylon
readings.text: [Micah 4:6] <dq>“In that day,”</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“<dn>I</dn> gather <dn>את</dn> the lame, and <dn>I</dn> bring together <dn>את</dn> the outcast and <dn>את</dn> those whom <dn>I</dn> have afflicted.</dq> [7] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall make <dn>את</dn> the lame a remnant, and <dn>את</dn> the outcast a strong nation. And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shall reign over them in Mount Tsiyon,c from now on and forever.</dq> [8] <dq>“And you, O tower of the flock, stronghold of the daughter of Tsiyon, it shall come to you, the former rule shall come, the reign of the daughter of Yeru sha layim.”</dq> [9] Now why do you cry aloud? Is there no sovereign in you? Has your counsellor perished? For pain has gripped you like a woman in labour. [10] Be in pain, and deliver, O daughter of Tsiyon, like a woman in labour. For now you are to leave the city, and you shall dwell in the field. And you shall go to Baḇel, there you shall be delivered, there <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shall redeem you from the hand of your enemies. [11] And now, many nations shall be gathered against you, who are saying, “Let her be defiled, and let our eyes look upon Tsiyon!” [12] But they do not know <dn>את</dn> the thoughts of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, nor do they understand <dn>את</dn> <dn>His</dn> counsel. For <dn>He</dn> has gathered them like sheaves to the threshing-floor. [13] <dq>“Arise and thresh, O daughter of Tsiyon, for <dn>I</dn> make your horn iron and your hooves bronze. And you shall beat many peoples into pieces, and <dn>I</dn> shall seclude their gain to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and their wealth to the Master of all the earth.”</dq>

readings.title: The Coming Ruler and Deliverer
readings.subtitle: His Comings Forth are from Everlasting
readings.text: [Micah 5:1] Now you are raided, O daughter of raiders, a siege has been laid against us. They strike the Judge of Yisra’ěl with a rod on the cheek. [2] <dq>“But you, Běyth Leḥem Ephrathah, you who are little among the clans of Yehuḏah, out of you shall come forth to <dn>Me</dn> the One to become Ruler in Yisra’ěl. And <dn>His</dn> comings forth are of old, from everlasting.”</dq> [3] Therefore <dn>He</dn> shall give them up, until the time that she who is in labour has given birth, and the remnant of <dn>His</dn> brothers return to the children of Yisra’ěl. [4] And <dn>He</dn> shall stand and shepherd in the strength of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, in the excellency of the Name of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>His</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn>. And they shall dwell, for at that time <dn>He</dn> shall be great, to the ends of the earth. [5] And this shall be peace. When Ashshur comes into our land, and when he treads in our palaces, we shall raise against him seven shepherds and eight leaders of men. [6] And they shall shepherd <dn>את</dn> the land of Ashshur with the sword, and <dn>את</dn> the land of Nimroḏ at its entrances. And <dn>He</dn> shall deliver us from Ashshur, when he comes into our land and when he treads within our borders.

readings.title: The Remnant's Power and Purification
readings.subtitle: Vengeance on the Nations Who Did Not Obey
readings.text: [Micah 5:7] And the remnant of Ya‛aqoḇ shall be in the midst of many peoples, as dew from <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, as showers on the grass, which do not wait for man nor delay for the sons of men. [8] And the remnant of Ya‛aqoḇ shall be among the nations, in the midst of many peoples, like a lion among the beasts of a forest, like a young lion among flocks of sheep, who, if he passes through, shall both tread down and shall tear, and there is no one to deliver. [9] Let your hand be lifted up against your adversaries, and all your enemies be cut off. [10] <dq>“And it shall be in that day,”</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“that <dn>I</dn> shall cut off <dn>את</dn> your horses out of your midst, and <dn>I</dn> shall destroy <dn>את</dn> your chariots.</dq> [11] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall cut off <dn>את</dn> the cities of your land, and <dn>I</dn> shall pull down <dn>את</dn> all your strongholds.</dq> [12] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall cut off <dn>את</dn> witchcrafts out of your hand, and let you have no magicians.</dq> [13] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall cut off <dn>את</dn> your carved images, and <dn>את</dn> your pillars from your midst, so that you no longer bow down to the work of your hands.</dq> [14] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall pluck <dn>את</dn> your Ashěrim out of your midst, and <dn>I</dn> shall destroy <dn>את</dn> your cities.</dq> [15] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall take <dn>את</dn> vengeance in wrath and rage on the nations who did not obey.”</dq>
